verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents Experiment APIs for managing flags from CI, scripts, or your own tools, so an agent could drive flag management programmatically. The Experiment docs also describe audience targeting and turning a flag off, but they do not say these operations are exposed through the API. The documented MCP server only provides behavioral analytics context and answers, not flag control. missing for 10: explicit API documentation of flag creation, targeting-rule updates, and on/off toggling; any MCP tools for flag management; agent-oriented or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent create, target, and toggle feature flags through the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Manage flags, experiments, and deployments from CI, scripts, or your own tools with the Experiment APIs.
Release behind a flag, ramp to the audience you choose, and turn it off the moment something looks wrong.
Define the audience to target users by properties, cohorts, or segments.
